premises.text: Online fashion shopping lacks personalization, leading to uncertainty about fit
premises.evidence_span: What's missing in online fashion shopping is personalization. People still don't know how clothes fit when they are buying online.

premises.text: Consumers can create a personalized model to try on clothes virtually
premises.evidence_span: What if you can create your own model and try on clothes on that model?

premises.text: The fitting room experience allows users to visualize how clothes fit on their model
premises.evidence_span: Now, trying on clothes is as simple as dragging and dropping on the model.

premises.text: Retailers can digitize their collections and offer them through an API without upfront costs
premises.evidence_span: Once they are digitized, we offer this collection to the retailers who carry these designers using our API.

premises.text: The platform can process thousands of items per day for retailers
premises.evidence_span: The cool thing about this process is scalability. We can process thousands of items per day.

premises.text: Retailers gain access to valuable consumer data and analytics through the platform
premises.evidence_span: they get access to this amazing data, the analytics, which they never had access before.

premises.text: The platform aims to digitize fashion before manufacturing, enabling mass customization
premises.evidence_span: Just like music is digitized and online, fashion will be digitized before it's manufactured.

value.text: Consumers can try on clothes virtually, leading to better fit and reduced returns
value.evidence_span: This isn't just the world's first 3D fitting room and the world's first true-to-size styling room.

notes: Traction details and specific retailer names are excluded.
